_notes.rules: backtesting/options_st_directional (DayMachine). Every rule is the backtest's own code; the engine only turns ticks into candles and fills.
_notes.fills: Paper fill = option LTP at the decision moment (candle close + ~1.5 s). Backtest equivalent: open of the next 1-minute bar.
_notes.costs: net = gross - statutory charges (backtesting/options_pivot_intraday/costs.py). No slippage added on paper fills.
_notes.holidays: Used only to count sessions left to an expiry (2-sessions rule). 20-Oct is confirmed by Breeze listing the 19-Oct expiry. ADD the Nov-2026 Diwali/Guru Nanak dates from the NSE circular before those weeks.
_notes.lot_size: From Kite's instrument dump at start-up, never hardcoded.
